newsitem.title: USA: Teamsters look to European labor on UPS.
newsitem.headline: Teamsters look to European labor on UPS.

text.p: The Teamsters union said Tuesday that European labor groups plans demonstrations and other actions to show support for the Teamsters strike against United Parcel Service.

"The European unions that represent UPS employees are planning actions this week in support of our goals. It's unions in France and Germany, in Spain and Italy and in England that represent UPS employees," Teamster spokesman Rand Wilson said.
"They will do whatever they can do within the frameworks of their agreements with UPS and within the framework of European labor law to support Teamsters on strike for good jobs," he said.
The actions were expected mainly to take the form of public demonstrations. Teamster officials were en route to Europe Tuesday to address labor unions there.
Wilson said the Teamsters spent months in the run-up to the strike coordinating activities with an international council of UPS unions in Europe, Asia and Latin America.
